about: I’ve been building software professionally since 2016, starting with freelance fintech work and growing into nearly a decade across consulting and in-house product teams. That range means I can take a problem from rough idea to shipped, reliable software without needing a big team around me.

What I do best is take software that feels complicated and make it feel simple, designing intuitive systems that get out of people’s way. Increasingly that means putting AI to work where it genuinely helps, not just where it’s fashionable. Right now I’m on the product team at GoMeddo in the Netherlands.
When I step away from the screen, it’s usually for music, a long run, or a bike ride around Utrecht.
